title: Wales's most caps since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for Wales in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the end of the 2026 World Cup. Only caps from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Daniel James: Daniel James is 11th with 65, just outside.
notes.Ethan Ampadu: Ethan Ampadu had 63 at the end of the 2026 World Cup.
notes.Gary Speed: Gary Speed won 85 caps, only 31 of them from 2000.
notes.Craig Bellamy: Craig Bellamy won 78 caps; 7 came before 2000.
notes.Neville Southall: Neville Southall's caps all came before 2000.

sources: https://www.transfermarkt.com/ceapi/performance-game/<player id> (every match a player played, filtered to the national team and the date window)
checks: Counted match by match from Transfermarkt's per-game data, 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026, and checked against Wikipedia's list of Wales internationals (June 2026, at the cut-off) for the players who began after 2000, and Bellamy's by-year table (71 from 2000). They agree except Ashley Williams (86 Wikipedia and RSSSF, 87 Transfermarkt; 86 used). James 65, Roberts 64 and Vokes 64 agree in both.
